description: This file defines the DevMainLauncherActivity class, which serves as a minimal launcher activity that sets a specific theme and immediately starts another activity (IndiceActivity). It is used to satisfy strict analyzers requiring a single launcher activity entry point.

classes.name: DevMainLauncherActivity
classes.description: A launcher activity that sets a theme and forwards immediately to another activity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the theme, launches IndiceActivity, and finishes itself.
